title: BOOKTIME MAGAZINE - JULY & AUGUST 2026. FREE TO DOWNLOAD!
description:
In this edition, we have lots of author interviews. Frank Ashwood tells us more about his fascinating book on the hidden life of soil (see pages 4 & 5); Katie Holmes about her book on the unsung pioneers of women’s athletics (see page 15); Marion Gibson about her history of witch trails in the late 17th century (see page 25); and Jason Arday about his memoir of his remarkable life (see page 29). We also interview Matson Taylor about his new novel set in Rome in the 1970s (see page 10); Joss Wood about her new spooky summer romance novel (see page 13); Frances Quinn about her novel exploring a early women’s football team (see page 14); C.D. Major about her new Gothic suspense novel set on a remote Scottish island (see page 12); and Kate Lord Brown about her novel following the life of a female fashion designer (see page 22).

For younger readers, we interview Catherine Doyle about her new illustrated book exploring the lives of mythical beings (see pages 50 & 51), Laura HenryAllain about her new picture book featuring characters Maya and Marley (see page 33); Alex Falase-Koya and Ken Wilson-Max about their picture book of a boy and a cat who inspire each other (see page 47)
